items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Talk to Wynton Marsalis about that, Wynton will tell you.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. One of the founding giants of jazz, it’s very modest, the neighborhood, I mean that’s where you say really down home and down to earth.
Well he was from New Orleans, New Orleans is like that. Talk to Wynton Marsalis about that, Wynton will tell you.
His wife wanted to move, but he didn’t, he said “No”. He was comfortable, he enjoyed where he was.
